sentences.text: Ebrachosuchus is classified as a reptile.

The only known fossil is a complete skull missing both lower jaws, designated as holotype BSPG 1931 X 501. The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — was found at Ebrach Quarry in bed number 9 of the Blasensandstein Member of the Hassberge Formation.
Oskar Kuhn first named the genus Ebrachosuchus and its type species E. neukami in 1936.
Ebrachosuchus belongs to the parent group Parasuchidae and is classified within the family Parasuchidae.
Ebrachosuchus was a basal phytosaur that lived during the Late Triassic in Bavaria, southern Germany. It lived between 237 and 227.3 million years ago during the Carnian stage.
